title: LinkedIn Launches Hiring Assistant 2 With Better Memory and Candidate Matching
key_facts: LinkedIn launched Hiring Assistant 2, covered by Social Media Today on 30 Sep 2026
Focus on reasoning, memory and personalization
Memory lets the assistant use characteristics of past hires such as location, industry and experience level
Shows match signals and candidate receptiveness signals from engagement, Open to Work and InMail response
Adds trust indicators such as verification, more integrations and voice in pre-screening
LinkedIn says over 20,000 companies use its agentic hiring tools
LinkedIn says recruiters are four times more likely to contact a candidate sourced by Hiring Assistant
Models draw on data of more than 1.3 billion users
quote_evidence: LinkedIn has launched a new version of its AI powered recruitment tool, Hiring Assistant 2, now available in the app.
Over 20,000 companies use its ‘agentic hiring solutions.’
why_it_matters_hint: Memory of past hires and match explanations aim to make the first results more relevant.
notes: ALM Corp (6 Oct) relays a Social Media Today report of 30 Sep 2026, so the underlying launch is older than the window: score lowered by 1 (6 to 5). Original Social Media Today link not seen.
